name: Liphia Bullancie
original_name: リフィア・ブランシェ
source:
A girl who works at a flower shop in the Royal Capital. She is bright and innocent, but also quite naive.  She is very ignorant about romance, and does not notice the affection of the opposite sex at first.

Although she trusts the people around her, she does not become completely dependent on them, and she confronts even the biggest obstacles on her own.

[Translated from [url=http://fleur0.starfree.jp/chara.html]official website[/url]]

Flower Emblem: Angel Trumpets
